_about: SMF (Simple Machines Forum) overlay. Read from SMF source 2026-09-09: Db::$db->query($db_string, $db_values) substitutes {int:x}/{string:x}/{array_int:x}/{db_prefix} placeholders through replacement__callback, which escapes each value by type (Sources/Db/APIs/MySQL.php:151,281,293). The query TEMPLATE is the first argument and the values are the second — so the template is the sink and the value array is bound, exactly like $wpdb->prepare.

_notes.placeholders: A value never reaches the SQL text: it is passed in $db_values and substituted by type. Judging argument 1 (the array) as if it were SQL produced 17 of SMF's 37 verdicts.
_notes.arg: the sink is argument 0, the template. If a project builds that template from a request value, the verdict still stands — which is the case we want to keep visible.
